title: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO
summary: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries IPO is a ₹93.66 crore book-built issue priced at ₹130–₹142 per share, to be listed on NSE SME. It is open from November 25 to November 27, 2026, with allotment expected on November 30 and listing on December 2, 2026. The minimum investment is ₹2,84,000 for 2,000 shares.

sections.h: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Financials (In Crs.)

b.p: Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries Limited was incorporated in June 2022. It turns sugarcane into jaggery powder, khandsari sugar, jaggery-based food products and a range of sugarcane by-products. It also runs its own cane seed nursery, so it has a hand in the farming side too./nThe company sells in two ways. For business customers, it supplies jaggery powder, khandsari sugar and by-products. For everyday consumers, it sells ready-to-make jaggery products under the “Feel Guddy” brand: Jaggery Tea, Jaggery Coffee, Instant Rice Kheer, Jaggery Laddoo and Jaggery Lapsi./nVery little goes to waste. The company processes its own sugarcane into its main products, then sells what’s left over (bagasse, molasses, press mud and ash) instead of discarding it. Having its own seed nursery, in-house processing units and a zero-waste approach gives it a mix of products for both industrial buyers and retail shoppers./nThe company says it focuses on running efficiently, keeping quality tight, manufacturing sustainably and developing new products./nAs of March 31, 2026, it had 155 permanent employees across production, engineering, agriculture, administration, sales, finance, security and other functions.
Dipali Dattatraya Kulkarni, Dattatray Kashinath Kulkarni are the company's promoters of Shree Siddhivinayak Greentech Industries.
